base_controls.scope: r0 conditional C2 initial state; bounded adaptive prerequisite only

scale_rationale.fractions: Natural abundance-fraction unit1, including initial zero HeIII; no relative-to-tiny-state norm
scale_rationale.T_K: Fixed prospectively declared ionized-IGM thermal unit1e4K, numerical scale only
scale_rationale.ne_cm3: Fixed original H reference density; never the current state
scale_rationale.photon_cm3: Fixed original H reference density; never the current state
scale_rationale.Gamma_species: Fixed prospectively declared1e-12s^-1 photoionization-rate unit; numerical scale only, not fitted to candidate
scale_rationale.N_ref_distribution: L1 difference over all cells divided by original H reference density
scale_rationale.U_eV_ref_distribution: L1 difference over all cells divided by HI ionization energy times original H reference density

base_controls.scientific_denominator: UNCHANGED per-field fine maximum on its own full-history65 and129 subsets; zero maximum requires exactzero
base_controls.local_control_claim: Truncation heuristic only; target2e-7 and scales do not certify global2e-6
base_controls.step_failure_policy: Source/native/domain/ledger errors propagate failclosed; only measured temporal error rejects and shrinks
base_controls.hard_events_policy: Caller supplies physical source-band/cell birth crossings and source redshift knots; opacity thresholds inside continuous cell support are quadrature cuts, not independent hard time jumps; unresolved endpoint traces failclosed
